name: Example · Hotel lobby rebuilt from a film clip

assets.name: Concierge Middle-Aged Tailcoat
assets.description: Middle-aged concierge 1.8m Visitor rig facing +Z: deep purple tailcoat with red lapel piping, white shirt, black bow tie, light gray trousers, black shoes, slicked light brown hair with mustache, cream notepad in left hand and pencil in right hand held near chest.

assets.name: Lobby Boy
assets.description: Young lobby boy 1.8m articulated adult. Deep purple buttoned tunic with red piping, purple pillbox cap with gold LOBBY BOY band facing +Z, dark purple trousers with red stripe, black shoes, dark hair, medium skin.

assets.name: Older Doorman Greatcoat TopHat
assets.description: Older doorman 1.8m retaining Visitor rig. Very dark navy double-breasted greatcoat to knees with gold buttons, black trousers and shoes, black top hat, pale skin, hands at sides. Faces +Z.

assets.name: Grand Hotel Entrance Facade
assets.description: Cream 6m wide 3.5m tall entrance facade facing +Z with central double doors, tall side windows with grilles, arched transom with emblem and warm chandelier globes.

assets.name: Hotel Entrance Door Leaf
assets.description: White interior swinging hotel door leaf 1.0x2.2m, cream frame with tall open glass panel and brass pull handle. Hinge leaf at edge.

assets.name: Hotel Reception Counter 6m
assets.description: Long 6m wide cream reception counter 1.1m tall 0.8m deep facing +Z with flat overhanging top, plinth base, six paneled front inserts with brass trim and top brass rail.

assets.name: Cream lobby rear wall - three arched niches
assets.description: 8m wide 3.2m tall cream rear wall facing +Z with three evenly spaced arched niches, warm globe lights around rim, molding and flat back panels.

assets.name: Curved Lobby Side Desk
assets.description: Curved wooden lobby desk 2.2m wide 1.05m tall, warm medium wood panelled body with faceted bow front, cream curved countertop with overhang and thin brass trim band. Rear closed for proxy use.

assets.name: Tall Potted Palm 2m
assets.description: Tall potted palm about 2m tall in dark pot, brown trunk and lush green fronds spreading. Hotel lobby corner plant facing +Z.
